title: Don't Say "I Think" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "I think". Say this instead:
• I guess. (casual, not sure)
• I believe. (more formal)
• I reckon. (informal, British)
• In my opinion. (to give your view)
• It seems to me. (polite, less direct)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
